items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Moe Gale must've made him a good offer and he agreed to join the band... Everything has always been business with me... Moe Gale wanted me to... I think I went on the street for Moe Gale

ctx.x: Yeah. He was teaching there. So Jesse Price agreed -- Moe Gale must've made him a good offer and he agreed to join the band when we got there.
And we didn't rehearse with him. He just came down to the date that we played in Kansas City.
